explanation: `IsKilledByIdealPower` is defined in this library and does not appear in Mathlib. The statement says `∃ n, IsTorsionBySet R M (I^n)` holds for a finite product exactly when it holds for each factor. I searched Mathlib for pi-type torsion and annihilator lemmas. The closest hit is `Module.annihilator_pi`, which gives `annihilator (Π i, M i) = ⨅ i, annihilator (M i)`. Using it here would still require choosing a common exponent over the finite index set and monotonicity of ideal powers. That is more than a one- or two-line derivation, so I did not report it.
